title: ⚔️ “If you’re not exhausted from the war… you’re probably not in it.”
paragraphs: ⚔️ “If you’re not exhausted from the war… you’re probably not in it.”

There’s a battle that no one sees — fought in prayer, patience, and perseverance.
Every scar is proof that grace still works. Every tear is a testimony that you didn’t quit.
✨ “The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.” – Exodus 14:14
🎥 From “THE WAR WITHIN” — a story of faith, endurance, and divine strength.
